falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern relied on a higher low structure; a break below 4,800 would violate the support floor that defined that bottom formation, invalidating the pattern match and suggesting a lower low regime rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern featured VIX compression and declining fear; sustained VIX elevation above 25 indicates systemic stress re-emergence, contradicting the stabilization signal embedded in the 78% pattern match

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously falls more than 2% from current levels
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would signal a flight-to-safety bid in bonds during equity weakness, indicating recession panic rather than the soft-landing/growth-recovery dynamic that characterized the August 2024 bottom; the correlation breakdown falsifies the macro regime assumption

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
